title: AI Agents for Household Brands: Investigate Refill and Case-Quantity Disputes
summary: A Genie compares ordered, shipped, and claimed quantities from NetSuite and email using approved pack factors, then hands finance a cited review packet.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A household quantity-dispute Genie can compare the original sellable pack, shipment evidence, and customer claim while preserving refill, multipack, and case units. Give it approved conversions and require cited records for every material conclusion. The agent should identify the mismatch and next owner without inventing a pack factor or approving a credit.


Explore the complete[household consumables integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/household-consumables) for the systems and processes around this guide.
